prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Interactive Trait Archetype Redesign: Redesigns the pet selection screen into an interactive archetype picker where users choose personality traits to find their ideal pet match immediately. (why: Adoption stage drops off to 67.3% with an extremely high mean time of 1017 seconds, indicating decision fatigue during selection.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Custom Pet Photo Validation Screen: Adds a dedicated photo quality verification screen before rendering custom pets to catch formatting errors early. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or distorted pet visuals, contributing to adoption step friction.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Account Pet Conflict Guard Warning: Displays a explicit warning banner clarifying whether existing cloud pets will overwrite or merge with current adoption data. (why: 8 users reported pets missing or reset after signing in again with existing accounts during setup.)
3: [finish, copy] Desktop Control Hotkey Reference Banner: Adds a persistent reference card detailing keyboard hotkeys for toggling pet visibility and mute status. (why: Multiple support emails show post-onboarding confusion regarding how to hide or talk to the pet.)
4: [home, notification] Tray Docking Sound and Visual Flare Alert: Plays a distinct chime and triggers system notification when pet desktop rendering completes. (why: Users miss when pet renders onto desktop, causing high mean waiting time (2336s) and reports of pets not showing.)
5: [choose_path, layout] Story Intro Split Video Teaser Layout: Reconfigures the intro story screen into a split layout showcasing video previews of animated pets on live desktops. (why: Path selection stage suffers high mean duration (514s) due to lack of immediate visual context.)

scores.note: Adoption has the highest drop-off (32.7%) and high mean duration; redesigning this step targets the biggest bottleneck but requires major new UI work.
Both support emails and drop-off data confirm adoption friction, though custom photo validation targets a specific sub-flow.
Sign-in already has a high 94.6% pass rate, but explicit warning banner is low cost and addresses specific user support reports.
Finish step drops 26.5% of users and support emails highlight post-onboarding confusion around controls.
Funnel mean wait time (2336s) and support feedback directly point to users missing when pet rendering completes.
Path selection loses 19.3% with high mean duration, but creating a split video layout requires dedicated video and layout work.
